issues.description: Residual std 的单位换算错误，0.006545 MW 应为 6.545 kW，不是 6.545 W。
issues.rationale: 该错误会使残差标准差低估 1000 倍，直接影响读者对模型误差规模的理解。

issues.description: Early-stopping counter 的计数前后不一致。
issues.original_snippet:
- Epoch 38-50: Early stopping counter 1→14, no improvement
- Epoch 51: Val=0.3967, counter=15/25
- **Training stopped at epoch 51** (not early-stopping — counter 14 < patience 25)
issues.suggested_fix:
- Epoch 38-50: Early stopping counter 1→13, no improvement
- Epoch 51: Val=0.3967, counter=14/25
- **Training stopped at epoch 51** (manual truncation; not early stopping, because counter 14 < patience 25)
issues.rationale: Epoch 38--50 共 13 个未提升 epoch，epoch 51 后 counter 应为 14/25；现有写法会造成训练停止原因判断错误。

issues.description: Warm-restart 的数量、周期命名和收益归因不自洽。
issues.original_snippet:
7. Scheduler: CosineAnnealing → CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts (3 restarts, T_0=15, T_mult=1)
### Restart #1 (epoch 1-20, cosine cycle)
### Restart #3 (epoch 36-50)
- Epoch 37: Val=0.3867 (GLOBAL BEST), LR=9.6e-5
### Restart #4 (epoch 51+)
- WarmRestarts: restart #1 benefit +3.3%, restart #2 benefit +1.3%, restart #3 no benefit yet
- Training truncated at 51/100 epochs, 3rd restart barely started
issues.suggested_fix: 统一改为 cycle 表述：Cycle #1 (epochs 1--20) best=0.4052；Cycle #2 (21--35) best=0.3918, improvement=3.3%；Cycle #3 (36--50) best=0.3867, improvement=1.3%；Cycle #4 started at epoch 51 after the third LR restart and had no new best yet.
issues.rationale: 当前写法把 cycle 与 restart 混用，并称 restart #3 尚无收益，但 epoch 37 已给出全局最优，会误导收益归因。

issues.description: 多处代码式标识含未转义下划线，作为 LaTeX 正文会报错或排版异常。
issues.original_snippet: film_scale; theory_net; portfolio_manifest; soc_transition_loss + anti_overlap_loss; T_0=15, T_mult=1; soc_weight=0.1
issues.suggested_fix: 将代码/配置标识写成 \texttt{film\_scale}、\texttt{theory\_net}、\texttt{portfolio\_manifest}、\texttt{soc\_transition\_loss}、\texttt{anti\_overlap\_loss}、\texttt{soc\_weight}；超参数写成 $T_0=15$ 和 $T_{\mathrm{mult}}=1$。
issues.rationale: LaTeX 文本模式下裸下划线不是合法普通字符，模型配置名也应以等宽字体区分。

issues.description: 多处数学和单位表达采用代码/纯文本写法，不符合 EPSR/LaTeX 风格。
issues.original_snippet:
- Test MSE: 9.0e-6 MW²
- Val Loss == Val MSE for ALL epochs (soc_weight=0.1 contributes <1e-6)
- Epoch 1 Train/Val gap: 244,000x (720948 vs 2.95)
| Metric | V2 | V3 | Δ |
issues.suggested_fix: 例如写成 $9.0\times10^{-6}\,\mathrm{MW}^2$、$\Delta$、$\mathrm{validation\ loss}=\mathrm{validation\ MSE}$、$244{,}000\times$；将 ALL 改为 all。
issues.rationale: 科学计数法、单位、等号和倍数应进入数学模式；全大写强调和代码式 == 不适合期刊正文。

issues.description: MSE、MAE、RMSE、SOC、LR 等缩写首次出现时未定义。
issues.original_snippet:
- Test MSE: 9.0e-6 MW²
- MAE: 2.21 kW
- RMSE: 2.96 kW
- SOC violation: 0.0
- Epoch 1: Train=720948, Val=2.9517, LR=3.6e-5
issues.suggested_fix: 首次出现时写成 mean squared error (MSE)、mean absolute error (MAE)、root mean squared error (RMSE)、state of charge (SOC)、learning rate (LR)。
issues.rationale: EPSR 面向跨领域读者，关键指标和控制变量缩写应在首次使用时完整定义。

issues.description: 句子带有审阅指令口吻，且 baseline 前缺少冠词，不适合作为论文正文。
issues.original_snippet: Review the PhysFormer V3 training results against V2 baseline. Identify what improved, what regressed, and what can be further optimized.
issues.suggested_fix: We compare the PhysFormer V3 training results with the V2 baseline and identify improvements, regressions, and remaining optimization opportunities.
issues.rationale: 期刊正文应使用陈述式学术表达，避免命令式任务说明。
